title: Telemetry Budget Guard
user: Engineers adding OpenTelemetry to a small service who need to prevent cardinality, retention, and log-volume changes from silently creating an unaffordable observability bill.
smallest_useful_product: A CLI that consumes a bounded redacted OTLP sample and collector config, estimates cardinality/storage/egress deltas for rule changes, and fails a declared budget in CI.
success_measure: Teams keep measured telemetry ingest within 20% of the pre-merge estimate for three successive releases.
